notes: $poolManager resolves to Ethereum mainnet's Uniswap v4 PoolManager and $token to the freshly deployed RISK. Deploy RISKHook directly with CREATE2 at flags 0x20c4 (beforeInitialize, beforeSwap, afterSwap, afterSwapReturnDelta). The pool charges static 1.25% LP fees plus 1% of the actual unspecified-currency fill, collected as claims. Anyone can sweep RISK fees to the dead address and execute hourly buybacks using up to 25% of IMD claims, bounded 300 bps from the hook's time-weighted reference; partial fills retain unspent claims. The factory receives all 1e27 token units and performs the 10% swarm / 90% pool distribution.
